# 點心派對插畫

使用內建 imagegen 產生，2026-09-12。三張圖已存入本資料夾，遊戲以 CSS 格線定位顯示，保留 file:// 開啟能力。

- friends.png：5 欄 × 2 列，10 位黏土風格夥伴，依序布丁龍、草莓兔、泡泡龍、星星貓、橘子狐、布啾、花花龜、啵啵、皇冠熊、毛毛。
- garden-words.png、space-words.png：7 欄 × 4 列，依 data/words.js 的明確 WORD_ART_ORDER 對應，不可任意換格子。

## 角色提示詞

Create a single wide sprite atlas with exactly 5 columns by 2 rows, ten equal cells. One different adorable full-body little creature per cell, centered with generous padding. Same solid pale cream background #fff5df. Reading order: mint-green baby dinosaur with orange spikes; pink fluffy bunny with strawberry hat; sky-blue dragon with stubby wings; lavender cat with yellow star on belly; peach-orange fox; yellow chick with leaf hat; teal turtle with flower shell; coral octopus; lilac bear with tiny crown; turquoise fluffy monster with two little horns. Handmade clay toy style, big expressive eyes, happy open mouths, stubby limbs, soft matte textures, lively pastel colors. No dividers, no text, no crossing cell borders, landscape 2.5:1.

## 點心花園題庫提示詞

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: preschool vocabulary game illustration atlas. One single image with EXACTLY 7 columns and 4 rows of equal SQUARE cells, landscape 7:4 aspect ratio. Strict grid, no borders or lines or letters. One clearly recognizable object per cell, full object centered with 15% padding, same warm pale cream background. Cute handmade clay toy style, vibrant colors, soft studio light, rounded friendly forms. Simple unambiguous vocabulary objects, no extra props, no faces added to inanimate objects, no text. Read from left to right then top to bottom. The 28 objects IN THIS EXACT ORDER are: steamed bao bun with pleated top; red apple; cute kitten; tiny house; birthday cake; bunny; bottle of milk; carrot; glass of fruit juice; greeting card with heart; butterfly; chicken egg; skirt; watermelon slice; friendly spider with eight legs; caterpillar; lion; piece of cooked meat; smiling mouth with lips; strawberry; small forest of three trees; chair; human baby doll; umbrella; white goose; pink heart; motorcycle safety helmet; human ear. Keep each object within its own cell, uniform scale and isolated silhouette.
